name: Mount Erlang Tunnel
facts: Mount Erlang Tunnel, 4,176 meters long, opened December 8, 1999, cutting three years of construction and 470 million yuan investment to slash travel time on the perilous Sichuan‑Tibet Highway.
The newer Erlangshan tunnel, 13,433 meters, completed in 2018, ranks 11th longest worldwide, burrowing 1,500 meters beneath seismic fault zones before emerging onto the Xingkang Bridge.
Both tunnels were engineered to replace a hazardous highway stretch notorious for landslides, rain, and fog, dramatically reducing accidents and improving safety for thousands of daily commuters.
